title: Polarity graph lower bound for the Turan number of K22
difficulty_reason: The non-routine obligation is the construction that identifies point and line roles on a single finite-field vertex set through ax+by=1. This polarity compression reaches the sharp leading constant 1/2 while retaining the at-most-one-common-neighbor property; the author also handles self-incidence by the p-or-p-1 degree count. Counting separate point and line parts only gives a weaker constant. Finite-field linear algebra and the prime-gap/PNT rounding are mature prerequisites; the graph design and its exact extremal role are supplied here. This is a substantive construction rather than a routine substitution into a quoted theorem. H2 is the proposed level; historical authorship and full printed proof do not decide difficulty.
